description: Write a Python ETL script (pandas + pyarrow) for adtech_platform that converts JSON Lines event files to Parquet when the JSON structure drifts between lines. The script should: (1) parse line by line, writing malformed lines with their line number to a reject file, (2) cast user_id to string, since it arrives as either a number or a string, (3) flatten props into props_page (string) and props_dur_ms (nullable Int64), (4) keep tags as list<string>, preserving the difference between an empty list and null, (5) include optional fields listed in the target schema (referrer) as null when absent, and collect any unexpected field names into a drift report instead of silently dropping or adding columns.
edge_cases: Line 4 is truncated JSON: it goes to rejects with line number 4 and the other three lines are still converted
user_id mixes int and str; left as object dtype, pyarrow raises or writes inconsistent types across files
props_dur_ms has missing values: a plain int column becomes float (1200.0); use nullable Int64
'ab_bucket' on line 3 is not in the target schema and must be reported in the drift report
tags [] (e2) and tags null (e3) must remain distinguishable
common_failure_modes: FM5: Schema inferred from the first lines drops or mistypes fields that appear later
FM5: Mixed-type columns written with different Parquet types per file, breaking downstream readers
FM7: Malformed lines skipped silently with no reject record
